name: ghost-platform-ring-controller
description: The ring controller (LLD-4 §04/§05/§06b): deterministic software with no model in its path. It takes one published digest through four rings in a fixed order, one tenant at a time, advancing only when a ring has baked and is healthy, on top of the per-tenant bump state machine and its abort flag, which never interrupts the migration step and pages at least once when a tenant can be neither verified nor undone.
